name: RC-B10-0482/2026 – After § 1 – Am 4/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: 1a. Strongly condemns the war waged by Saudi Arabia on the Yemeni people; strongly condemns the blockade of Yemeni ports and airports by Saudi Arabia and the air strikes, which have led to a catastrophic human rights situation; calls on Saudi Arabia to immediately end its blockade and to comply fully with international law;
